places.quote: the Marshalsea gate had shut for ever on all those perplexed possibilities of a time that was gone
places.note: The debtors' prison; the passage refers to it as the Marshalsea gate.

places.quote: had reached Bleeding Heart Yard, with the news of her sister’s marriage
places.note: Plornish's neighbourhood court; the passage does not state the district explicitly.

places.quote: which Happy Cottage knows I neither make it up nor any ways enlarge
places.note: Proper name of the Plornishes' home, used as a figure for the household; likely in Bleeding Heart Yard.
